name: get_credit_balance
description: Check the remaining prepaid credits for the bearer token configured on this MCP connection. This call is free and does not consume credits.

name: get_safe_head
description: Return the conservative Base Mainnet safe head after consulting both configured public RPCs. If the RPC quorum is unavailable or inconsistent, the call fails closed and the spent credit is refunded. Costs 1 credit.

name: get_transaction_status
description: Check whether a Base Mainnet transaction is not found, confirmed, safe, or failed using two independent RPCs. No payment assumptions are made. RPC quorum/inconsistency failures refund the credit. Costs 1 credit.

name: decode_usdc_transfers
description: Decode all native Circle USDC Transfer logs from a Base transaction only after dual-RPC receipt agreement and safe finality. A not-found, failed, or not-yet-safe transaction is returned as an assurance result; RPC infrastructure failures refund the credit. Costs 1 credit.

name: verify_usdc_payment
description: Assure that a specific Base transaction contains an exact native Circle USDC Transfer from the expected payer to the expected receiver for the exact atomic amount.
